svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.rectangular-prism-six-face-net", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Trace a nonsquare rectangular-prism net with side lengths8,24,32mm,three pairs of congruent rectangular faces and five whole-edge hinges. Abstract folding gives six face normals and eight prism vertices. No square-face cube equivalence is claimed. Outer edges and fold references differ by line pattern/native-dot pitch. Source words and dimensions are not reproduced;real-model folding and learner recognition remain pending.", "geometry_exception": "Swell/ViewPlus share1.4mm outer boundaries and1mm dashed fold hinges. Native1.2mm Index dots use denser outer boundaries and sparser fold references with explicit junction guards. Cylinder end circles separated6mm from rectangular lateral surface for tactile clarity,not attached paper hinges. All alternatives stay in the same master;no exact source reconstruction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots,notBraille. All logical vertices retain single dots;outer boundaries are denser than approximately8mm fold-reference pitch. Deliberate near-junction guards prevent clusters. All-pairs clearance checked;actual tactile continuity remains pending.
